The '''1928–29 Scottish Division One''' season of Association football was won by [[Rangers F.C.|Rangers]] by sixteen points over nearest rival [[Celtic F.C.|Celtic]]. [[Third Lanark A.C.|Third Lanark]] and [[Raith Rovers F.C.|Raith Rovers]] finished 19th and 20th respectively and were relegated to the [[1929–30 Scottish Division Two]].
